capabilities: Capture lines into today's daily note with automatic wiki links
Create tasks with due dates parsed from phrases like 'next fri'
Link unlinked mentions in existing notes
Triage an Inbox.md file, filing each line into the right note
Build people dossiers and match event guest lists against the vault
disambiguation: Not a backlink manager or link-suggestion tool; it writes new linked lines into daily notes and only reports or retro-links unlinked mentions.
extras: Primarily a Python CLI (bl) used outside Obsidian; the Obsidian plugin only covers capture and retro-linking and shares the same linker test cases. Runs fully offline with no account or network access, and every write is atomic with per-file undo.
motivation: Plenty of plugins already link note titles as you type. This one is for capture with the exact rules of the CLI.
problem: Quick capture normally means opening Obsidian, finding the right note and typing wiki links by hand, so mentions of people and topics go unlinked and never show up in backlinks.

relations.evidence: Tasks are copied without their checkbox, so they don't show up twice in the Tasks plugin.
If you use Periodic Notes, its daily settings win over the core plugin's
an MCP server so Claude can file notes and research people for you

summary: Capture tool that appends a line to today's daily note from a terminal, phone inbox or Claude, wiki-linking people, companies and topics already in the vault.
